outcome: infant neurodevelopment (cognitive, receptive communication, expressive communication, fine motor, gross motor functions)
cohort: 1609 pregnant women and 1759 infants, including singletons and twins, conceived naturally or via assisted reproductive technology, were followed from gestation.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid exposure, particularly dexamethasone, was significantly associated with an increased risk of infants being noncompetent in the cognitive development domain at 1 year of age.
